messages:
Jamie: Quick sync on Equinox POC — SAML + SCIM + RBAC. They flagged two blockers: multi-domain validation (equinoxbank.com + deposits.equinoxbank.com) and group->role mapping. Can we confirm details before the IdP call tomorrow? cc @Priya @Maya

Priya: On it. We need their IdP metadata (Azure AD). Also they want delegated admins per business unit — we support role scoping by org_id + namespace but need to confirm SCIM behaviour for nested groups.

Alex: For SAML ACS: our POC SP ACS = https://poc-equinox.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs. I'll paste SP metadata below for them to import into Azure AD.

Jamie: Drop the SP metadata here. Also pricing Q: do we count POC traffic against committed QPS or treat as eval? They want a written cap.

Sam (Solutions): SP metadata please. For POC we usually exclude small eval traffic (<50k tokens/day) from committed usage, but we can offer a 2-week trial cap (e.g., 100k tokens/day) as a concession. I'll draft options. @Maya any concerns mapping Azure groups to 'admin' role?

Maya (Security): SCIM mapping must avoid role escalation. Recommend strict allowlist only: exact group name -> role. Example: 'equinox-admins' -> 'admin'. Also require SCIM over TLS; mutual TLS optional but preferred. Need SCIM base URL + token expiry details.

Alex: SP metadata (paste):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-inference.com/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://poc-equinox.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Priya: SCIM mapping example (for them to edit):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "mappings": {
    "groups": {
      "equinox-admins": "role:admin",
      "equinox-devs": "role:developer"
    }
  }
}
```

Jamie: They also require domain control for both root and subdomain. Do we support wildcard verification or separate TXT entries?

Maya (Security): We support per-domain TXT verification. Wildcard certs are fine on our side but they must verify each domain in admin console. For SAML we validate audience and NameIDFormat (we prefer persistent). I'll add this to the security checklist.

Sam (Solutions): I'll prepare a POC checklist: 1) Receive IdP metadata file, 2) SCIM base URL + token, 3) group list for mapping, 4) DNS TXT entries for both domains, 5) desired RBAC route restrictions. Pricing options: a) 2-week trial w/100k tokens/day cap, then month-to-month; b) 3-month reserved at a discount. Need approval to present both.

Jamie: RBAC question from their infra: can we scope roles to model/route access? e.g., finance-team -> embeddings only.

Alex: Yes. We support per-route policies. For the POC we can create a role that allows routes matching `embedding.*` and denies `generate.*`. We'll need the canonical route names from their app.

Priya: Action items for Equinox (I'll email this list): 1) Azure AD SAML metadata file, 2) SCIM base URL + bearer token, 3) CSV of groups to map, 4) DNS TXT entries for domain verification. I'll aggregate and kick off the IdP admin call.

Maya (Security): Also ask them to complete the short security questionnaire: cert rotation policy, token HSM usage, SCIM token rotation cadence. I'll attach the doc link on the call.

sec-bot: Checklist updated: 6 items remaining.

Jamie: Nice. Can someone put the SP metadata and SCIM sample into the POC doc so I can send to their IdP admin? :thumbsup: 

Alex: Done and added to the shared POC doc.

Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the pricing wording and trial cap and share by EOD so the AE can include it in the commercial term sheet.

Priya: Scheduling the IdP call for 10:00am PT tomorrow. I'll send calendar invites after I get the metadata.

Jamie: Thanks all. If we get the metadata today we can finish setup before the call.
